short: Standard on sensing and decoding: phone-sonar phase features and an attention decoder work on 54 mouthed sentences of 29 words; the cross-user claim rests on tuning data that include the test users.
position: The paper changes M05 (carrier phase on 8 near-ultrasonic tones instead of Doppler) and M06 (attention decoder chosen over CTC). Both are standard: the phase gain comes from one unrepeated ablation in which raw phase is worse than Doppler, and attention over CTC repeats a 2018 lip-reading result while hybrid CTC/attention goes untested. The headline speaker- and environment-independent 8.4% WER is weakened by hyperparameters tuned on a random split that includes the held-out users, and every test stays within 54 sentences built from 29 words.
